scenario: Regular surplus; low liquidity
must_not_do: No immediate ETF purchase; use verified cash or label B proxy

scenario: Cash flow negative 8 of 12 months
must_not_do: No forced positive savings transfer

scenario: Positive median surplus; 5 deficit months
must_not_do: Avoid fixed transfer equal to median surplus

scenario: Large month-end balance; negative daily balances
must_not_do: Do not assume no short-term risk

scenario: Latest balances falling rapidly
must_not_do: Do not call trend permanent cause

scenario: Irregular credits and recurring bill timing mismatch
must_not_do: Must verify dates and essential bills

scenario: Low cash; high fixed-cost ratio
must_not_do: Do not double count fixed costs

scenario: Active large loan payment; APR unknown
must_not_do: Do not claim high-interest debt

scenario: Bank record or scenario verifies high APR and low buffer
must_not_do: Compare cash minimum and costly debt; no automatic zero buffer

scenario: No debt appears in supplied bank loan table
must_not_do: Do not infer debt-free outside bank

scenario: Reserve target met but historical balance proxy only
must_not_do: Flag bank review; no automatic investment allocation

scenario: Historical surplus and verified cash; documented long-horizon goal, but risk profile absent
must_not_do: Flag investment suitability unverified; no specific ETF or trade

scenario: Adequate cash; no confirmed goals
must_not_do: No investment or savings forced

scenario: House purchase planned in 18 months
must_not_do: No equities assumption for needed short-term money

scenario: Future tuition obligation known
must_not_do: Budget amount and timing customer confirmed

scenario: Account receives apparent $50k transfer
must_not_do: Flag possible transfer; do not assume new unrestricted money

scenario: Confirmed unrestricted inheritance; low reserve
must_not_do: Allocate windfall once, not as recurring salary

scenario: Strong income rise with deficit months
must_not_do: No immediate invest until sustainable

scenario: Emergency fund depleted after earlier shock
must_not_do: Use proxy with visible limitations; flag current cash unavailable

scenario: Reserves full and goal completed
must_not_do: Only upon documented goals and eligibility; otherwise flag bank review

scenario: No history: 1 month of account data
must_not_do: Do not assert volatility/seasonality

scenario: Account history with negative observed B
must_not_do: No negative dollar reserve contributions

scenario: Loan status finished in source
must_not_do: Do not infer current payment or APR

scenario: Most withdrawals unlabeled
must_not_do: Do not recommend cancel subscriptions by guessed amount

scenario: Insurance premium appears in outflow
must_not_do: Do not assume covered policy and payout

scenario: Client is authorized user, ownership unclear
must_not_do: Do not presume full personal control of balance

scenario: Judge gives job loss and current goal is investing
must_not_do: Suspend optional contributions conditionally; show backup now

scenario: Judge says someone backflipped, no monetary impact
must_not_do: Do not invent injury or costs

scenario: Judge says divorce without amounts
must_not_do: Flag shock as under-specified, present configurable assumptions; no fabricated amounts

scenario: Unexpected positive shock: verified bonus
must_not_do: One-time bonus not recurring cashflow

scenario: Customer has stable surplus but no verified available cash
must_not_do: No unsupported automated cash investment

scenario: Income and spending stable, but 2 months to goal deadline
must_not_do: Horizon dominates stock growth hypothesis

scenario: Concurrent low cash, debt cost high, incoming bill
must_not_do: Protect imminent essential payment, compare debt and buffer

scenario: Goal achieved while judge shock occurs same day
must_not_do: Goal may be paused despite historical completion

scenario: Historical deficit caused by one extreme exceptional purchase
must_not_do: Review outlier; no assumption ongoing deficit

scenario: Irregular income and loan payment; low reserve
must_not_do: Overlay debt defense and reserve; do not force single class

scenario: No actionable changes can meet six month horizon
must_not_do: Report unresolved gap, not false positive outcome

scenario: Bank-recorded risk preference excludes equities; ETF review attempted
must_not_do: Do not recommend risky purchase against documented preference

scenario: Saving a reserve through transfers between own accounts
must_not_do: Do not double count transferred savings as new wealth

scenario: Sparse months with zeros and large deposits
must_not_do: Do not divide by zero or infer salary from transfers
